invitation_paragraph: More precisely we celebrate from June 13 to 14. In Chinese, the numbers 13 and 14 are pronounced similarly to a phrase meaning 'for a lifetime'.
intro_paragraph: Our engagement took place in Shanghai on the Suzhou Creek. It was a private, special moment away from the busiest tourist spots on the Bund.
reception_p: We'll take photos with you at this time.
map_paragraph: In front of Shanghai's famous skyline Jenny said yes; now we'll celebrate with you in the heart of Hamburg! The party will be at Favorite Hammonia at Alsterufer 9 in Hamburg.
rsvp_paragraph: Please let us know by 13.03.2026 whether you will join and if you have dietary requirements (e.g. vegan, vegetarian, allergies).
tips_anreise_p: The easiest way to reach the venue is by public transport. The nearest S-Bahn station is Dammtor. From there it's one stop to the main station, where you can transfer to other lines. There are limited paid parking spots on site.
tips_uebernachtung_p: We are getting married in central Hamburg; please check the usual booking platforms for accommodation — there are options for every budget.
tips_gifts_p: Your presence is the greatest gift. If you would like to give something extra, following Chinese tradition we appreciate monetary gifts in an envelope. In Chinese this is called a “HóngBāo” (红包) — a red envelope symbolizing luck and good wishes. It doesn't have to be red for us: please place your gift in an envelope with your name on it so we can thank you later.
witnesses_paragraph: We look forward to games and guest contributions, but please coordinate them with our witnesses Sebastian Schilling and Leonie Finnern so they don't get out of hand. They are also available for any other questions. Contact details are available on request.
